name: assembly-newsh2-115
summary: Brass dome works dug into brown dirt, 48 x 56 px from four 2x2 pieces: on a dark grey machinery bed sits one big polished brass sphere (a raised vertical hatch band down its middle with a visor bar over a dark window, a vertical slot on each side), flanked by grey pylons; two smaller brass spheres below it carry grey gun blocks and are fed by short brass pipes from the big dome; a third brass sphere at the bottom has a round dark gun port; a grey neck with a pipe runs between them and grey struts reach out at the bottom. Shape language: round, polished brass spheres (as tall as half their width or more) set on hard, chamfered grey machinery.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: brass dome about 25 x 21 px, round outline matching the sprite
tall: about half its width or more (10-12 px), not a lens
one mid brass tone, metallic; the sprite's bright spots and dark lower-right rim are sheen and shadow, not paint
features.note: The big brass sphere that dominates the structure (concept: a riveted brass ball).

traits: raised vertical band down the middle of the dome, cols 13-23, lit left edge at col 13
upper hatch plate (rows 7-10), a raised visor bar across it (row 11, the bright line)
a dark window recessed under the visor bar (rows 13-14) and a darker brass lower plate (rows 15-19)
all conform to the dome's curve with crisp edges
features.note: The baseline's visor bar, dark window and brass plate; the concept reads it as a hatch band with an upper and lower hatch.

traits: one dark vertical slot each side of the hatch band (cols 10-11 and 25-26, rows 9-14)
cut in: dark inside a raised brass frame, not painted on
features.note: Concept: two vertical vents on the sphere's flanks.

traits: two brass spheres about 12 x 10 px (left at col 7, right at col 30, row 31)
round: about 6 px tall or more, not squashed
same brass as the main dome
features.note: Box: the left one; the right one is identical.

traits: grey box on the lower right of each side dome, cols 6-10, rows 30-34
stands proud of the dome's surface with chamfered edges
lighter grey than the bed
features.note: Box: the left one. Concept: grey gun housings with nozzles below.

traits: brass sphere about 12 x 10 px at col 18.5, row 40, round, about 5 px tall or more
a round dark gun port at col 19, row 41.5, set in a brass rim (a bore, not a painted spot)
features.note: The baseline's third dome and dark gun port (concept: a ball with a big round muzzle).

traits: short brass pipes from under the main dome down to each side dome (col 8 and col 30, rows 21-26)
constant diameter, about 2-3 px, round
features.note: The brass pixels between the big and small domes; the concept draws them as elbow pipes.

traits: grey blocks either side of the main dome (cols 2-7 and 32-36, rows 9-28) with a wider foot
hard, chamfered, taller than the bed
lit left edge (col 3) is a bevel, not a stripe
features.note: The grey frame beside the dome.

traits: grey machinery block between the side domes, cols 14-24, rows 22-35
a vertical pipe down it at col 20 (the lighter column), from under the main dome to the bottom dome
features.note: Concept: a bundle of pipes running down the middle.

traits: thin bright brass rod running diagonally at the main dome's lower right, from about (23, 22) to (30, 17)
round, constant diameter
features.note: The baseline's light rod (the bright diagonal pixels).

traits: grey bar running down and right from the bottom-left of the bed (cols 8-14, rows 39-48) and a grey block at the right (cols 27-31, rows 39-42)
chamfered, a little above the bed
features.note: The grey struts at the bottom of the bed.

traits: dark grey machinery platform following the sprite outline, a low step above the dirt
brown dirt floor around it
